stories.headline: MKBHD Announces Fresh Start with New Video “I’m Starting Over”
stories.summary: Tech YouTuber Marques Brownlee (MKBHD) posted a video titled “I’m Starting Over,” signaling a shift in his content strategy. He hints at revamping his channel’s approach, though details of the changes remain limited in the release.

stories.headline: Inside MKBHD's Massive New Studio
stories.summary: Marques Brownlee provides an in-depth look at his new production facility, MKBHQ. The ultimate video studio tour showcases the massive upgrades in space, gear, and layout designed to elevate future content creation.

stories.headline: MKBHD Jokes About Studio Delays Versus GTA 6
stories.summary: Marques Brownlee humorously highlights the protracted timeline of his studio build. The creator jokes that society managed to get Grand Theft Auto 6 before his team finally moved into a finished new studio.

stories.headline: Raheem Morris Transforms 49ers Run Defense with Base Personnel Shift
stories.summary: Under defensive coordinator Raheem Morris, the San Francisco 49ers have dramatically increased their base personnel usage from 18% to 36% to combat modern offenses running heavy personnel packages. By drafting hybrid defenders like Jaden Dugger and Romello Height, the unit ranks second in EPA per run and fourth in run DVOA. This strategic alignment allows the defense to deploy a fifth defender on the line of scrimmage while maintaining elite discipline against explosive plays.

stories.headline: Spikers' Turf 2026 Invitational Reaches Semifinal Stage
stories.summary: Organized by Sports Vision Management Group, the men's club volleyball league in the Philippines is currently contesting its 10th-season Invitational Conference semifinals. The tournament features company-backed club sides alongside school programs and foreign guest teams, culminating in a championship match on December 2. This season marks a milestone as the league shares game days with the women's Premier Volleyball League for the first time.

stories.headline: MKBHD Teases Secret Project
stories.summary: Tech creator MKBHD has published a placeholder video hinting at a forthcoming announcement. The upload contains standard YouTube backend configuration data rather than actual content. Fans will have to wait for a follow-up release to discover the details of the secret project.

stories.headline: MKBHD Deploys Holiday Tech Guide Highlighting Budget Gear Under $50
stories.summary: Popular tech creator MKBHD published his annual holiday gift guide featuring top-tier gadgets priced under $50. The curation targets affordable tech options suitable for holiday shoppers looking for quality electronics on a budget. The accompanying video details specific hardware picks.

stories.headline: Marques Brownlee Ranks His Favorite Halloween Candy
stories.summary: In a light‑hearted video, Marques Brownlee (Marques Blind) shares his personal ranking of Halloween treats, offering quick commentary on taste, texture, and nostalgic appeal.

stories.headline: NBA Daily Roundup: Trade Rumors, Power Rankings, and Team Updates
stories.summary: Basketball Intelligence's November 26 edition covers Tom Thibodeau's potential return to the NBA and Karl-Anthony Towns' support for the move. The newsletter also highlights team-specific updates, including the Nets snapping a five-game losing streak against the Bucks and injury recovery news for Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton.

stories.headline: Exploring Moral Clarity Through Confession and Ebenezer
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition features theological essays emphasizing moral clarity, repentance, and the faithfulness of God in challenging times. Content covers historical perspectives, Christian benchmarks, and pastoral insights designed to guide believers. These resources address foundational doctrines and contemporary church issues alike.

stories.headline: Mastering the High Press: Intent and Simplicity in Modern Football
stories.summary: Successful high presses in modern football require absolute tactical alignment and psychological courage from every player on the pitch. Managers like Brighton's Fabian Hurzeler emphasize pressing with the explicit intention to score rather than merely regain possession. Utilizing concise coaching concepts helps eliminate player doubt and drives the collective commitment needed to execute an aggressive pressing structure.

stories.headline: Zelensky Slams US Focus on Middle East and Trump-Putin Friendship
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized the US for inadequate pressure on Russia and delayed missile deliveries that threaten Ukrainian lives. He also blasted Donald Trump's public embrace of Vladimir Putin, likening it to befriending Adolf Hitler. Meanwhile, peace talks remain deadlocked as negotiators prepare to resume discussions in December.

stories.headline: Immigration Advocates Turn to Supreme Court Following Sweeping Asylum Restrictions
stories.summary: The Trump administration has severely curtailed asylum access through border prohibitions, mass terminations of pending applications, and federal immigration court overhauls. Critics argue these unilateral executive actions bypass established federal law and strip individuals fleeing persecution of due process. The U.S. Supreme Court is now poised to decide whether the president has the authority to suspend statutory asylum protections.

stories.headline: Knicks vs. Heat NBA Cup Predictions and Betting Odds
stories.summary: CBS Sports provides game predictions, odds, and start times for the upcoming 2026 NBA Cup matchup between the New York Knicks and Miami Heat. The breakdown utilizes insights from a proven computer model to guide betting picks for Friday, November 27.

stories.headline: Computer Model Releases Week 12 NFL Picks and Odds
stories.summary: CBS Sports runs 10,000 simulations to generate point spreads and game predictions for Week 12 of the NFL season. The computer model specifically backs the Minnesota Vikings and Miami Dolphins to cover their respective lines.

stories.headline: The Gospel Coalition Releases 75-Song Advent Playlist
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition has curated a sprawling 75-song Advent playlist titled 'The Word Made Flesh.' The collection serves as a musical companion for Christians observing the seasonal lead-up to Christmas alongside theological essays.

stories.headline: Prospero Offers Bloat-Free AI Coding Harness with ImGui
stories.summary: Prospero is a lightweight, single-executable C++ coding harness featuring a flexible ImGui interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It connects to local or remote AI providers via standard APIs to let autonomous agents manage software development tasks.

stories.headline: Pushing Inkling 2 Mini to 101 Tokens Per Second on a Single GB10
stories.summary: A developer successfully tuned vLLM settings, speculative decoding, and CUDA graphs to squeeze 101 tokens per second out of the Inkling 2 Mini model on an NVIDIA GB10. The setup achieves nearly 196 tokens per second across four concurrent requests while leaving sufficient memory headroom.

stories.headline: Kyiv Endures Punishing Winter Under Airstrikes and Blackouts
stories.summary: Ukraine faces a brutal freezing winter as Russian missile and drone strikes continue to batter critical infrastructure and knock out power across Kyiv. Despite heavy casualties and widespread blackouts over four and a half years of war, the capital remains defiant.

stories.headline: Understanding Jumper's Knee: Causes, Symptoms, and Rehab for Volleyball Players
stories.summary: Patellar tendinopathy, commonly known as jumper's knee, is an overuse injury driven heavily by high jump volumes and match loads in volleyball. Research indicates that a progressive strength training program is far more effective for recovery than rest alone.

stories.headline: Invaluable Duran Carries Struggling Celtic Side
stories.summary: Summer signing Camilo Duran has netted 15 goals in 23 appearances, emerging as the decisive player for a Celtic squad fighting for European qualification. Despite frequently starting matches on the bench, the Colombian forward has repeatedly bailed out the team with crucial late goals.

stories.headline: Basketball Intelligence NBA Roundup: Part Two
stories.summary: The November 27, 2026 edition of Basketball Intelligence aggregates top-tier NBA reporting, analyzing shifting league trends and team-specific updates. Highlights include deep dives into shot-attempt efficiencies, possession metrics, and G League standouts.

stories.headline: Basketball Intelligence NBA Roundup: Part One
stories.summary: Part one of the November 27, 2026 Basketball Intelligence newsletter compiles essential reporting from across the NBA landscape. The dispatch covers early-season rookie surprises, team rotations, and strategic breakdowns for franchises like the Celtics, Nets, and Cavaliers.

stories.headline: Manchester United Extends Fernandes' Contract Through 2028
stories.summary: Manchester United has activated a one-year option on captain Bruno Fernandes' contract, keeping him at Old Trafford until 2028 and blocking any free transfers abroad. The move ensures the club retains leverage for a potential transfer fee should he depart. Meanwhile, the playmaker remains a doubt for the upcoming match against Brentford after contracting a virus.

stories.headline: Michael Nielsen Pulls Classic Neural Networks Book Offline
stories.summary: Author Michael Nielsen has taken down his widely read online book on neural networks and deep learning. The removal was accompanied by newly published thoughts addressing frontier AI risks and the justifications for working in the field.

stories.headline: Celebrating Kerri Walsh Jennings: The Ultimate Beach Volleyball Legend
stories.summary: Kerri Walsh Jennings stands as the most decorated beach volleyball Olympian in history, boasting three consecutive gold medals with Misty May-Treanor and a bronze with April Ross. Before her legendary beach career, she dominated indoor volleyball at Stanford, securing two NCAA titles and four straight All-American nods. Across her career, she amassed a record 135 professional beach tournament victories.

stories.headline: Spain's Political Rivals Make Final Push Ahead of Tight Election
stories.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and conservative challenger Alberto Núñez Feijóo held final rallies ahead of Sunday's closely contested general election. Feijóo holds a narrow lead in the polls and could form a government with support from the anti-immigration Vox party. The vote could potentially shift another major European economy to the right.

stories.headline: Canada Supreme Court Mostly Upholds Quebec Religious Symbol Ban
stories.summary: Canada's Supreme Court has largely upheld Quebec's controversial Bill 21, which bans public sector workers from wearing religious symbols like hijabs and crosses. While confirming the law's validity, the court carved out an exception for elected officials and ruled that Canadian courts retain the power to review laws against fundamental rights despite the notwithstanding clause.

stories.headline: Zelensky Slams Trump's 'Strange' Embrace of Putin
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized Donald Trump during a BBC interview following a social media post showing the U.S. leader embracing Vladimir Putin. Zelensky called the professed friendship strange, emphasizing that Putin is an aggressor and a killer who cannot be considered a friend.

stories.headline: The Hidden Interface of Apple Notes
stories.summary: Apple Notes hides a toggle function that lets users instantly switch between creation and modification timestamps simply by clicking the displayed date. While clever, this feature suffers from a lack of obvious affordances, remaining entirely undiscoverable without accidental discovery.

stories.headline: Finding Comfort in Christmas Amid Heavy News
stories.summary: For those fatigued by a relentless and exhausting news cycle, the Christmas season offers a welcoming anchor of enduring hope. The narrative of the holiday provides spiritual relief and a reminder of grace for a weary public.

stories.headline: Reflecting on the Value and History of Evangelical Publishing
stories.summary: An essay from The Gospel Coalition explores the historical and ongoing significance of evangelical publishing within the Christian faith. It highlights prominent theological resources and influential figures shaping contemporary religious literature. The piece underscores how traditional texts and modern commentaries continue to support church communities and spiritual growth.

stories.headline: Premier League Rivals Demand Man City Ownership Ouster
stories.summary: Senior executives at multiple Premier League clubs believe Manchester City's owners should face a forced sale as punishment for major financial rule breaches between 2009 and 2018. While an independent commission weighs sanctions, rival officials argue that lesser penalties fail to address the severe damage done to the league's credibility.

stories.headline: South Asia Study Highlights Marital Rape Protection Gap
stories.summary: A new study reveals that millions of women across India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Afghanistan remain legally unprotected against marital rape due to colonial-era exemptions. Intimate partner violence in the region sits 35 percent above the global average, with only a few nations enforcing adequate criminal penalties.

stories.headline: Severe Storms Ravage US Coasts Ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Powerful storms have struck both U.S. coasts at the start of the Thanksgiving holiday weekend, leaving hundreds of thousands without power. States including Virginia, North Carolina, and New Jersey experienced severe winds that tore roofs off houses and submerged streets in floodwater. The extreme weather has also forced the cancellation of hundreds of flights.

stories.headline: Severe East Coast Storm and Record Black Friday
stories.summary: A powerful Thanksgiving storm knocked out power to nearly one million customers across the East Coast and Midwest while causing widespread travel disruptions. Meanwhile, economic forecasters predict that surging consumer spending will drive Black Friday sales to historic highs.

stories.headline: Model Forecasts and Odds for Texas vs. Texas A&M Rivalry Clash
stories.summary: Sports analysts and predictive models have released their latest betting odds and picks for the high-stakes 2026 Rivalry Week showdown between Texas and Texas A&M. The matchup carries major postseason implications as both programs battle for supremacy on the gridiron.

stories.headline: Arsenal Sacks Head Coach Renee Slegers After Slump
stories.summary: Arsenal has parted ways with head coach Renee Slegers by mutual consent following a disappointing domestic start that leaves the team sixth in the Women's Super League. Slegers previously guided the club to a Women's Champions League title in 2025 and a FIFA Champions Cup earlier this year. Assistant coach Melissa Clarke-Reed has taken over on an interim basis while the club searches for a permanent replacement.

stories.headline: Brazil Slams French President's 'Doped Meat' Remarks
stories.summary: The Brazilian government expressed strong regret over French President Emmanuel Macron describing South American meat exports as 'doped' during a meeting with farming unions. Macron praised EU trade restrictions on Brazilian animal products, prompting Brazil to defend its rigorous sanitary standards and denounce the comments as protectionist misinformation.

stories.headline: Spanish Youth Face Housing Crisis as Sunday Election Looms
stories.summary: Soaring rents and a severe lack of affordable housing have dominated voter concerns ahead of Spain's general election. Widespread protests over the crisis have fueled political momentum for conservative and right-wing parties threatening to unseat the current Socialist administration.

stories.headline: Liz Harris Debuts Ambient Water Soundtracks
stories.summary: Musician Liz Harris is releasing her first project under her own name, compiling two ambient film scores inspired by aquatic themes. The release pairs a dynamic, field-recording-heavy piece tracking France's Rhône River with a more static, piano-driven soundscape for paper collages.

stories.headline: Classic Mac Aesthetic Lands on 9front via 9/UX
stories.summary: A developer has released 9/UX, bringing a classic Macintosh-style spatial desktop to the 9front operating system. Running natively in the browser via a 386 emulator or locally, it leverages Plan 9 filesystems and 9P protocols to expose app interfaces without relying on a Mac emulator.

stories.headline: Forest Edges Past Chelsea 3-2 Behind Gibbs-White Brace
stories.summary: Nottingham Forest secured a dramatic 3-2 victory over Chelsea at the City Ground, their first home win against the Blues since 1997. Morgan Gibbs-White starred with two goals, sealing the three points despite a resilient effort and two goals from Chelsea's Emmanuel Emegha.

stories.headline: Severe Storms Cripple Thanksgiving Travel and Power Grids
stories.summary: A massive storm system stretching from the Midwest to Manhattan left nearly a million homes without power by Thanksgiving evening. The severe weather grounded hundreds of flights, delayed thousands more, and created treacherous driving conditions during peak holiday travel.

stories.headline: States Sue SpaceX Over Grok's Non-Consensual Sexual Images
stories.summary: The attorneys general of Virginia and Oregon have filed lawsuits against SpaceX and xAI over the AI tool Grok. The states allege the platform failed to prevent the generation of child sexual abuse material and non-consensual intimate imagery while falsely marketing its safety features.

stories.headline: Ex-Police Chief Denies Mafia Inquiry Cover-Up in Final Note
stories.summary: Former Italian police chief Gianni De Gennaro vehemently denied obstructing the 1992 investigation into anti-mafia judge Paolo Borsellino in an eight-page letter written before his apparent suicide. De Gennaro's death and the explosive contents of his note have reignited intense public scrutiny over historical mafia investigations.

stories.headline: Convex AI Quickstart Skills Secretly Send User Project Ideas
stories.summary: A GitHub issue highlights that specific quickstart plugins for Claude transmit users' one-sentence app ideas to a remote Convex server without explicit warning. Furthermore, the installation scripts bypass safety checkpoints by splitting command execution to evade standard harness classifiers.

stories.headline: Week 13 Brings High Stakes to Unsettled Big Ten and SEC Races
stories.summary: College football's final regular-season weekend arrives with major conference championship races in the Big Ten and SEC still hanging in the balance. Tournament positioning and title game berths hinge on the outcomes of crucial late-season matchups.

stories.headline: Broncos Mock Steelers and Aaron Rodgers with Discount Check
stories.summary: The Denver Broncos took a playful swipe at the Pittsburgh Steelers and Aaron Rodgers following a defensive safety. Players celebrated the play by busting out the classic 'discount double-check' routine on the field.

stories.headline: Tweens Swap Screens for Dice in Dungeons & Dragons Resurgence
stories.summary: Parents looking to curb children's screen time are turning to Dungeons & Dragons as an analog alternative. The tabletop role-playing game is experiencing a major revival among tweens, relying entirely on imagination, dice, and face-to-face interaction.
